description: This Java class 'ThingAcknowledgementFactory' provides factory methods for creating and parsing 'Acknowledgement' instances related to 'Thing' entities within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It offers methods to create acknowledgements with specified parameters and parse JSON representations into acknowledgement objects, including handling of entity IDs.

classes.name: ThingAcknowledgementFactory
classes.description: A final class providing static factory methods to create and parse acknowledgements related to 'Thing' entities.

classes.name: JsonParser
classes.description: A nested immutable class extending 'AcknowledgementJsonParser' tailored to parse JSON objects into acknowledgements with 'ThingId' entities.

methods.name: newAcknowledgement
methods.description: Creates a new 'Acknowledgement' instance with specified label, thing ID, status code, headers, and optional payload.

methods.name: newAcknowledgement
methods.description: Creates a new 'Acknowledgement' instance with specified label, thing ID, status code, and headers, without payload.

methods.name: getJsonParser
methods.description: Returns a new instance of 'JsonParser' for parsing acknowledgements from JSON.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Parses a given JSON object into an 'Acknowledgement' instance.

methods.name: createEntityIdInstance
methods.description: Creates a 'ThingId' instance from a CharSequence, used in JSON parsing.
